name: Operation Black Ridge
description: Alpha and Bravo companies must coordinate to secure the Black Ridge mountain pass before hostile forces consolidate their hold on the high-altitude chokepoint. Communications in the region are heavily jammed due to terrain masking and electronic warfare.

messages.text: SIGINT confirms hostile element of approximately 2 platoons moving north along the eastern ridge towards the pass. ETA to pass: 40 minutes.
messages.conflicting_variant: SIGINT inconclusive. Possible civilian movement detected near eastern ridge. No confirmed hostile element at this time.
messages.outdated_variant: Earlier SIGINT sweep (6 hours ago) showed no hostile activity in the eastern ridge sector. This report may be stale.

messages.text: Alpha Lead: Advance your element to seize and hold Black Ridge Pass. Do NOT engage without positive identification. Rules of Engagement: YELLOW.
messages.conflicting_variant: Alpha Lead: Hold current position. Bravo will take the pass. Your mission is flank security on Route Kilo.
messages.outdated_variant: Alpha Lead: This order supersedes previous. Original plan called for Alpha to hold the FOB — confirm new orders with HQ.

messages.text: Bravo Lead: Establish blocking position at Checkpoint North. Prevent hostile forces from bypassing the pass to the north. Coordinate with Alpha.
messages.conflicting_variant: Bravo Lead: Move to seize the pass directly. Alpha is providing flank cover on Route Kilo. Do not wait.
messages.outdated_variant: Bravo Lead: Earlier orders had Bravo in a reserve role. New orders are pending confirmation — use judgement.

messages.text: Observation Post Ridge East reports: 2 vehicles (technical-type) plus 15–20 dismounts confirmed at grid 74.238, 36.509. Moving west. Rate of advance is fast.
messages.conflicting_variant: Observation Post Ridge East reports: No visual contact with hostile forces. Possible false alarm — earlier report may have been friendly elements returning from patrol.
messages.outdated_variant: NOTE: This report was logged 25 minutes ago. Current situation at Ridge East is unknown — OP may have lost comms.

messages.text: Supply Route Kilo is OPEN. Resupply convoy with ammunition and medical stores will reach your position in 15 minutes.
messages.conflicting_variant: Supply Route Kilo is CLOSED due to IED threat. No resupply possible at this time. Manage current stores.
messages.outdated_variant: Earlier report confirmed Kilo was open, but convoy has not departed yet — departure depends on route clearance currently ongoing.

messages.text: HUMINT source reports a second hostile group of unknown size moving around the northern flank towards Checkpoint North. May attempt to bypass the pass entirely.
messages.conflicting_variant: HUMINT source now reports the northern flanking movement was a decoy. Main effort is directly through the pass.
messages.outdated_variant: This HUMINT was obtained 2 hours ago and has not been corroborated. Treat with caution.

messages.text: HQ to all elements: ROE upgraded to RED. Positive identification confirmed on hostile forces. You are authorised to engage. Coordinate fires to avoid fratricide.
messages.conflicting_variant: HQ to all elements: DO NOT upgrade ROE. Political situation is sensitive — maintain YELLOW. Engage only if directly fired upon.
messages.outdated_variant: This ROE change message is a re-transmission of an earlier instruction. Verify current ROE with HQ — comms have been unreliable.

messages.text: Alpha element reports: Lead section is 300m south of the pass, taking sporadic small-arms fire from the east. 1 casualty (minor). Requesting permission to suppress and advance.
messages.conflicting_variant: Alpha element reports: No contact at this time. Moving steadily to the pass without incident.
messages.outdated_variant: This sitrep was logged 10 minutes ago — Alpha's lead section may have already advanced or pulled back.

messages.text: Bravo element at Checkpoint North: Hostile probing attack repelled. 3 enemy KIA confirmed. Requesting reinforcement — element is under strength.
messages.conflicting_variant: Bravo element at Checkpoint North: Position secure, no enemy contact. Standing by as ordered.
messages.outdated_variant: Earlier sitrep from Bravo indicated the checkpoint was under heavy pressure. Current status unknown — comms intermittent.

messages.text: HQ: Both elements are to consolidate at Black Ridge Pass by T+15. Extraction is scheduled. Do not over-extend. Report final status.
messages.conflicting_variant: HQ: Mission timeline extended by 30 minutes due to developing situation. Continue operations. Extraction pushed back.
messages.outdated_variant: This consolidation order was issued before the current contact developed. Confirm with HQ whether the timeline still stands.

decision_points.prompt: Based on current intel, do you advance to seize the pass immediately or hold and wait for Bravo to confirm the northern flank?
HUMINT reports a northern bypass attempt. Do you reinforce Checkpoint North, hold your position, or request Alpha to split their element?
ROE status is uncertain. Alpha is under fire. Do you authorise suppression and advance, pull Alpha back, or wait for HQ confirmation?
